item.title: Crowds at parades leading to crowds of flu patients in Urgent Care
item.description: Carnival season may have only ended three days ago, but it's still flu season. Doctors said the crowds along the parade routes are already translating to crowds of patients with the flu.

item.title: Fifth Circuit Court rules public schools in Louisiana can display Ten Commandments
item.description: The U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that public schools in Louisiana can immediately start posting displays of the Ten Commandments on Friday, Feb. 20, vacating a preliminary injunction that had blocked the law.
